Bangkok, Thailand324 contributions

Italian flavour with an ocean view
Feb 2026 • Friends
This is the only Italian restaurant at InterContinental Danang, and it has recently been beautifully renovated. The space feels relaxed and open, set in a thatched-roof pavilion that welcomes the sunshine and sea breeze, creating a laid-back beachside atmosphere that’s perfect for a long, leisurely meal.

The menu focuses on coastal Italian flavours, with a lighter and more modern approach to classic recipes. You’ll find fresh seafood, grilled meats, handmade pastas, and artisanal pizzas. The pizza here is definitely a highlight — thin, crisp, and full of flavour, and easily one of my favourite dishes on the menu.

But what I loved most was the view. The restaurant sits right by the sea, so you’re dining with the ocean just in front of you. With the sea breeze and the sound of the waves in the background, it’s the kind of place where you naturally want to slow down and enjoy the moment.

While meeting multiple tables at the same time, it was impressive to be able to provide us with personalized services, and I was convinced that you were capable of being a leader.

What was most impressive was that he didn't just serve food, he made memories with a young heart. Brian is a natural mix of efficiency and warmth, and I believe he is perfectly realizing the values of InterContinental.

Thank you very much for Brian's excellent service and that evening was a special moment for us to remember forever.
